_meta.description: Phase 5 Task 5.2 — Maps every claim in every paper section to the supporting evidence entry. Claims marked EVIDENCE_MISSING must not appear in the paper.

claims.claim: TCL achieves mean forgetting 0.116 [95% CI 0.080, 0.153] on Split-CIFAR-10, n=5 seeds
claims.notes: CI computed via t-distribution df=4, t=2.776

claims.claim: SGD achieves mean forgetting 0.233 [95% CI 0.229, 0.237]
TCL vs SGD: delta=-0.117, p=0.0012, d=3.68, 5/5 seeds, Bonferroni-significant (k=4)
TCL vs EWC: directional improvement delta=-0.075, p=0.019, d=1.70, 5/5 seeds; does NOT survive Bonferroni (k=4, threshold 0.0125)
claims.verdict: DIRECTIONAL — must be framed as directional only

claims.claim: Governor-alone performs worse than full TCL; p=0.023, d=1.60, 5/5 seeds; governor-alone also worse than SGD
Thermodynamic regime-detection LR adjustment never activates (rho=0, sigma=0)
SI default collapses to chance-level accuracy (0.500) across all 5 seeds
claims.verdict: DIRECTIONAL — observational finding from Phase 10 data; not independently pre-registered

forbidden_claims: TCL significantly outperforms EWC (Bonferroni-corrected) — evidence_id: phase10_controlled_rerun_tcl_vs_ewc, EVIDENCE_MISSING: p=0.019 does not meet threshold 0.0125
HPC variant achieves lower forgetting — evidence_id: hpc_autonomous_high_penalty_conservative, paper_citation_allowed=false
TCL generalises across datasets — evidence_ids: phase16_cifar100_*, phase17_tinyimagenet_*, all paper_citation_allowed=false

claims.claim: EWC computes Fisher importance from a uniform average of the final N batches
Continuous importance accumulation via EMA corrects EWC's snapshot bias
claims.evidence_source: Theorem 1 — EMA is unbiased estimator of diagonal Fisher as T->infinity

claims.claim: Motivation for this paper: Phase 10 controlled comparison showing directional TCL advantage over EWC

forbidden_claims: The thermodynamic governor is a primary mechanism — EVIDENCE_MISSING (Phase 11 falsifies this)

claims.claim: EWC (Kirkpatrick et al. 2017) uses diagonal Fisher as importance weights for elastic regularization
SI (Zenke et al. 2017) accumulates importance online via parameter path integrals
Three continual learning scenarios: task-incremental, class-incremental, domain-incremental (van de Ven & Tolias 2019)
This paper addresses task-incremental scenario only
claims.evidence_source: All Phase 10/11 experiments use task IDs at test time

claims.claim: ThermalImportance EMA accumulator: v_i^(T) = (1-beta) sum_{t=1}^{T} beta^{T-t} g_i(t)^2
E[v_i^(T)] = F_{ii}(1 - beta^T) -> F_{ii} as T->infinity
EWC's uniform average is the limiting case beta->1 of the EMA
Under non-stationary gradients, EMA has exponentially smaller bias than EWC's uniform snapshot
Elastic penalty: L_TCL = L_CE + lambda * sum_i v_i^(T) * (theta_i - theta_i^*)^2
Governor (regime-detection LR adjustment): rho=0, sigma=0 in all production traces — mechanism never activates

forbidden_claims: Governor LR adjustment improves performance — EVIDENCE_MISSING: Phase 11 falsifies this

claims.claim: TCL forgetting 0.116 [0.080, 0.153] vs SGD 0.233 [0.229, 0.237]; delta=-0.117, p=0.0012, d=3.68, Bonferroni-significant
TCL forgetting 0.116 [0.080, 0.153] vs EWC 0.191 [0.162, 0.220]; delta=-0.075, p=0.019, d=1.70, directional only (Bonferroni fails, k=4)
SI (default hyperparameters) accuracy=0.500 (chance level) across all 5 seeds; forgetting=0.092
Phase 11 ablation: full TCL 0.127 vs penalty-only 0.143 vs governor-only 0.250 vs SGD 0.219
Full TCL vs governor-only: delta=-0.123, p=0.023, d=1.60, 5/5 seeds; governor-alone also worse than SGD
Full TCL vs penalty-only: delta=-0.016, p=0.315, d=0.51 — not significant; n=26 needed for 80% power
claims.verdict: DIRECTIONAL — must disclose: uninformative null at n=5

forbidden_claims: HPC outperforms TCL — paper_citation_allowed=false in inventory (evidence_id: hpc_autonomous_high_penalty_conservative)
TCL outperforms EWC on CIFAR-100 — EXPLORATION_GRADE (n=3, paper_citation_allowed=false)
TCL outperforms SGD on TinyImageNet with d=75.08 — EXPLORATION_GRADE (n=3, d is artifact, paper_citation_allowed=false)
DER++ or LwF comparisons — GPU experiments not run, no data

claims.claim: Bonferroni correction at k=4 raises family-wise threshold to p=0.0125; TCL vs EWC (p=0.019) fails this threshold
Cohen's d=3.68 for TCL vs SGD — very large effect; Cohen's d=1.70 for TCL vs EWC — large effect
Power analysis: Phase 10 TCL vs SGD has 100% power at d=3.68, n=5; TCL vs EWC has 92.5% power at d=1.70, n=5
LIMITATION 1: Governor never activates (rho=0, sigma=0); governor-alone < SGD; LR adjustment is not a productive mechanism
claims.verdict: REQUIRED_LIMITATION — PUBLICATION_ALLOWED finding in negative direction

claims.claim: LIMITATION 2: rho=0, sigma=0 in all examined production traces; thermodynamic LR adjustment has never fired
LIMITATION 3: Task-incremental protocol only; task IDs provided at test time; class-incremental and domain-incremental untested
claims.evidence_id: ALL — scope constraint across all experiments

claims.claim: LIMITATION 4: Single backbone (ResNet-18); ViT and other architectures untested
LIMITATION 5: TCL vs EWC (p=0.019) does not survive Bonferroni correction at k=4 (threshold 0.0125)
LIMITATION 6: DER++ and LwF not included; Phase 2 comparison scripts written but GPU experiments not run
TCL's continuous gradient-energy importance accumulation significantly reduces forgetting vs SGD on Split-CIFAR-10
The elastic penalty is the entire productive mechanism; the governor contributes nothing
Future work: HPC replication at n=20 (pre-registered), CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet reruns at n=5, DER++ and LwF baselines
claims.evidence_id: EVIDENCE_MISSING — future work, not a current result
